goal: Deliver structured log entries with metadata directly to libbitcoinkernel consumers
Avoid forcing downstream users to parse formatted strings for timestamps, levels, and categories
Decouple the kernel library from node-specific logging internals
agreement: Strong support for rationalizing the kernel logging API and dropping dispatcher indirection (ryanofsky)
Objection answered without reply: using a singleton logger introduces viral coupling (purpleKarrot)
Resolved concerns regarding init ordering, argument evaluation, and bad alloc safety (ajtowns, w0xlt)
Author recently pushed fixes for cleanup callback invocation order on error (musaHaruna)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because structured log entries remove brittle string parsing for kernel consumers
P2 because dropping node logging internals advances decoupling and unblocks later refactors
